name: Rhapsody's Tale
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Before the flight, I drank me a whole keg of stout. Hiccup!

And what a flight it was. Zipping around with Brohann following me. Didn't see no temple though. Hiccup!

Well, didn't see no temple till I got a little too tipsy and fell off my mount. I plunged right into the water and was sucked down. Found myself surrounded by a bunch of creepy trolls. Sure swam out of there fast! Even made off with this troll souvenir. Here, take it to Brohann and let him know his temple is down there, indeed. Hiccup!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Rhapsody Shindigger! That's right... how could I forget such a name?

So he knew about the sinking of the temple all along? Well, that certainly would have saved you some leg work.

But this Atal'ai artifact! Why, it's quite a find!
narrative.requestItemsText:
At long last you have returned, adventurer. It has been quite some time since we last spoke. I thought perhaps you had forgotten about my quest.

Did you locate that wily gryphon rider? Did he have anything to report?

quests.name: In Search of The Temple
quests.objectiveText: Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind wants you to search for the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

quests.objectiveText: Speak with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Gryphon Master Talonaxe
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe inside the Aerie Peak Aviary.

quests.name: Rhapsody Shindigger

quests.name: Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail
quests.objectiveText: Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands wants you to bring him 3 Roc Gizzards, 3 Groddoc Livers and 3 Ironfur Livers.

quests.name: Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
